documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust volume growth, an increasing share of value-added and studded jewellery, and the expansion of the advance gold model and exports. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 reached INR2,391 crores, up 61% year-on-year, while reported PAT grew 93% to INR129 crores. The company highlighted improvements in working capital efficiency, positive operating cash flow, and strengthened internal controls and audit frameworks. Management reiterated that under SEBI guidelines, they do not provide forward-looking business guidance. Sky Gold & Diamonds reported strong financial growth for H1 FY27, with revenue reaching ₹4,403.5 crore and a PAT margin of 5.3%.

guidance.claim: The company previously guided for ₹3,000 crore revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: The company maintains its revenue target of INR8,100 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company targets revenue of INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumers are shifting from 22-karat to 18-karat, 14-karat, and 9-karat jewelry.
demand_outlook.quote: Every quarter, we are seeing that there's a drastic change in the karatage shift from 22-karat shifting to 18-karat, 18-karat shifting to 14-karat and 9-karat.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing strong interest in international markets, specifically the U.K. and Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's manufacturing footprint has been expanded to 150,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to keep capex low by utilizing a leased model for future facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big.

capex_expansion.claim: Future capex requirements are estimated at INR80 crores to INR100 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for the quarter expanded by 133 basis points year-on-year to 9.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded 133 basis points to 9.6% versus Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Advance gold accounted for 16% of the business in Q2 FY27, adding 110 basis points to the gross margin.
margins_costs.quote: First, advance gold was 16% of our business in Q2 '27, ahead of our '27 target of 15%. Because we billed only making charges, it adds 110 basis points to gross margin while needing almost no working capital.

margins_costs.claim: The company's value-added share of business has increased, serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 9.3% in Q1 FY27, driven by a shift in product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a strict back-to-back hedging policy to mitigate gold price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: At that time, I had also emphasized that our profitability is not dependent on movements in gold prices because we follow strict back-to-back hedging policy.

orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters committed to taking salary only when there are operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, with all payouts occurring solely through dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's first priority for capital allocation is debt reduction.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends starting in FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: An exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores was recorded for a fraud incident at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra.
risks_headwinds.quote: This is after an exceptional charge of INR7.35 crores for the fraud incident at our subsidiary, Star Mangalsutra, disclosed in July.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted that the land sale completion timeline has been extended beyond August 2026.
Management acknowledged an incident involving INR10.7 crores, with legal proceedings underway.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to taking a salary only when there are operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: Promoters will only take salary when there is operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will receive payouts solely through dividends instead of salaries.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach a net debt-free balance sheet by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our aspiration is to build a company that is net debt-free, operations with a highly efficient balance sheet, maintains industry-leading working capital metrics and consistently converts a significant portion of its earnings into sustainable operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Management will revise revenue guidance post-Diwali.
management_commitments.quote: So, we will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
